author: Paul White
title: Bill Belichick Sends Strong Response After UNC Contract Buyout Rumors - NewsBreak
text:
By Paul White ,
1 hours ago
Bill Belichick is arguably the greatest head coach in NFL history with six championships and one of the longest-running dynasties in league history, the New England Patriots.
People began to question his value when legendary quarterback Tom Brady left the team and the Patriots immediately tanked.
Belichick and the team mutually agreed to part ways at the end of the 2023 season, and after a year away from the game, he took a college coaching position with the North Carolina Tar Heels.
It sounded promising initially, with a pro-style program and a complete roster overhaul, but the results have been frightening so far.
Sep 13, 2025; Chapel Hill, North Carolina, USA; North Carolina Tar Heels head coach Bill Belichick on the sidelines in the second quarter at Kenan Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Bob Donnan-Imagn Images © Bob Donnan-Imagn Images
The Tar Heels are just 2-3 with each of their losses being by more than 20 points. Rumors surfaced on Wednesday of a potential contract buyout with the team struggling and some controversy surrounding Belichick’s recruiting practices.
However, the legendary coach released a joint statement with North Carolina, telling fans, “I’m fully committed to UNC Football and the program we’re building here.”
Director of Athletics Bubba Cunningham also added, “Coach Belichick has the full support of the Department of Athletics and University.”
This is big news for all college football fans in the nation as it appeared that there was friction between Belichick and the school.
But it makes sense that both sides now appear to be happy and confident in each other, especially because the players have little to no cohesion and college players aren’t typically used to pro-style schemes.
After all, Colorado Buffaloes head coach Deion Sanders didn’t start out too hot with a brand new roster, going just 4-8 in his first season.
Last year, he took the team to new heights with a 9-4 record, so it appears the Tar Heels will have that same level of patience with Belichick.
It has been a rocky start to say the least, but the pairing says they have belief in each other, so it seems like Belichick will be there for at least the remainder of the season.
